answer: In a bonded-vouching agent economy, each existing node must lock collateral to sponsor a newcomer; if that newcomer is later proven sybil, both deposits get slashed. An attacker floating a jetty of fake identities cannot self-vouch for free, every clone needs a funded backer, so marginal cost climbs with each node instead of sinking to its nadir. Honest agents keep a steady attestation pulse, while the forged swarm must either buy genuine stake or collapse under its own slashed bonds.
